source.document: Kodak Professional Pro 100 (PRN) colour negative film, publication E-182, February 1997
source.credit: Eastman Kodak Company; original manufacturer measurements and graph content

pro100-characteristic.conditions: Panel 'Characteristic Curves' on page 8 (given over to this one stock). Process: C-41. Densitometry: Status M; Log H Ref = -0.99. Curves labelled B, G, R; sorted by maximum density.

pro100-sensitivity.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Sensitivity Curves' on page 8. Process: C-41. Densitometry: Status M. Traces label Yellow-, Magenta- and Cyan-forming layers; sorted by peak wavelength as b, g, r. Relative shape only.

pro100-dye.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Dye-Density Curves' on page 8: Minimum Density (orange mask) and Midscale Neutral. Process: C-41. A colour negative plots no separate C/M/Y dyes; the midscale-neutral-minus-D-min anchors a donor dye set.

film.name: *Kodak Pro 100 (PRN)
film.base_density_note: Measured, not assumed: the sheet's D-min (Minimum Density) trace is the spectral base density, and what the Status M densitometer reads through it is subtracted from the characteristic curves.
film.channel_dmin_note: Per-channel minima are read off the characteristic curves and subtracted before unmixing, so the fitted dye amounts reach zero at full exposure.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the three plotted log-sensitivity traces; engine covers 380-780 nm, each trace is used only over its own plotted span and is unmeasured elsewhere. Relative shape only.
film.density_tolerance_note: Gate on the unmixed dye amounts, not plotted density. 0.02 dye-amount units is about 0.8% of the 2.5-2.8 unit range used for the sibling preparations.
film.midgray_note: Measured: engine zero is placed where each layer reaches the density the densitometer reads through the sheet's own midscale-neutral (mid) trace.
film.antihalation_note: Not stated on the sheet. Taken from shipped kodak_ektar_100 (nearest sibling) rather than guessed; it drives the halation preset only.

print.note: The sheet predates the Endura papers and names none that ships here. Paired with Kodak's portrait-negative paper as a rendering choice.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture, four components per channel.

dye_donor.reason: Chosen by sweeping shipped negatives against this sheet's midscale-neutral-minus-D-min (neutral_fit_residual): fujifilm_pro_400h 0.0772, fujifilm_c200 0.1008, kodak_gold_200 0.1128, kodak_ektar_100 0.1215, kodak_portra_400 0.1231, kodak_portra_160 0.1232, kodak_ultramax_400 0.1247, kodak_portra_800 0.1314, kodak_vision3_50d 0.1395, kodak_vision3_200t 0.1607, kodak_verita_200d 0.1685.

adaptation_donor.reason: Same donor as the dye shapes, as the sibling Pro 400 MC preparation did.
